notes: This source/test traceability contract records Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 default-region realization in the non-installable embedded development profile. The RTI keeps the default region as derived, invisible state rather than inventing a public RegionHandle; it applies it to active object discovery/scope/reflection, ordinary and regional interaction routing, update-rate relevance, source association replacement/restoration, and receive-order and timestamped callback metadata. The Catch2 cases prove receive-order behavior plus direct time-constrained timestamped object reflection and interaction delivery, including the supplied-empty Convey Region Designator Sets callback convention after federation-owned TSO queueing. They do not independently validate a complete timestamped default-region matrix, relaxed DDM, all dimension/attribute combinations, distributed transport, save/restore, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.
